asA: chain author or stage-keeper on a downstream product upgrading from rcf-lite 0.36.x
iWant: commits that carry both the stage prefix and an agreeing Hand: trailer to pass while the trailer retires, and every old escape to fail with the replacement named
soThat: in-flight branches keep working through 0.37.x without any commit passing on a trailer alone
description: Transition rules, retired escapes and the class override file.
title: A chain author on a downstream product moves to the stage prefix through a transition that never loosens a check

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given fixture commits "DEFINE: criteria" with trailer Hand: test-author touching rcf/user-stories/us-1.json and "BUILD: code" with trailers Hand: builder and Hand-Id: b-1 touching src/x.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0, the PASS line reads "DEFINE 1, BUILD 1, REVIEW 0, TEST 0, FINALISE 0, merges 0, transition 2", and each --json row carries handTrailer naming its trailer value.

[failure] Given a fixture commit "BUILD: code" carrying Hand: test-author and touching src/x.js, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> Hand: test-author disagrees with BUILD: (role builder)".

[failure] Given fixture commits "FINALISE: chores" carrying Hand: mixed with "Separation-Reason: release regeneration" and "BUILD: rename" carrying Hand: mixed with no Separation-Reason, when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 4 with the item "<s7> Hand: mixed is retired; commit chores as FINALISE: within its file classes" for each, whatever paths they touch.

[failure] When rcf audit separation --require-hand runs in any fixture repository, then it exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --require-hand is retired; every commit needs a stage prefix" and prints nothing on stdout.

[happy] Given rcf/separation.json {"classes": {"rcfTest": ["spec/**"]}} at the head, a "BUILD: code" commit touching spec/a.js fails exit 4 naming spec/a.js with "(class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)"; given {"classes": {"test": ["spec/**"]}} (a 0.36.x name) the same commit fails the same way and stderr carries "[warn] separation: class test is read as rcfTest"; given {"classes": {"bogus": ["x/**"]}} the verb exits 2 with "separation: malformed rcf/separation.json: unknown class bogus"; given unparsable JSON it exits 2 naming rcf/separation.json.

[must-not] No trailer turns a failing commit into a pass: a "BUILD: add test" commit touching test/x.test.js fails with the class item whether it carries no trailer, Hand: test-author or Hand: mixed with a non-empty Separation-Reason; and a commit whose only marker is a Hand: trailer (no prefix) fails "no stage prefix" whatever the trailer says.

[edge] Given a fixture branch whose first commit is "BUILD: code" touching src/x.js followed by "TEST: evidence" touching only rcf/verify-reports/FBS-001/a.json, with no verdict file (the range starts after the round's DEFINE), when rcf audit separation runs, then it exits 0 on classes alone with "DEFINE 0, BUILD 1, REVIEW 0, TEST 1".

[edge] Given a fixture project at the root of its git repository whose rcf/separation.json at the head declares {"classes": {"rcfTest": ["spec/**"]}} and a "BUILD: code" commit touching spec/a.js, when rcf audit separation --base <base> runs from the project subdirectory src/, then it resolves rcf/separation.json at the project root (the directory holding rcf/manifest.json, as other verbs resolve it) and exits 4 naming spec/a.js with "(class rcfTest, owned by DEFINE)", as it does when run from the project root.
